content:
maria gomez: opened PR to tidy Dedicated capacity docs: clarify autoscale examples, fix SLA sentence around preemption vs eviction, and add a short SDK + terraform snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/610

samir patel: quick scan  please call out schedule-based scaling example and note that burst can briefly exceed max replicas if spare GPUs exist.

jo parks: added schedule example (yaml) and short note about burst being opportunistic. kept SLA change minimal: 'Provider preemption may occur; platform-initiated evictions are minimized.' linked glossary.

alex chen: spotted a broken internal link in migration appendix; replaced with public mirror and kept internal anchor for on-prem tips. also adjusted GPU-family table to use ranges (e.g., "~0.8-1.3x") with a caveat.

docs-bot: link-check: 2 broken (one fixed). TOC build: success. Preview: https://deploy-preview-610--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:

maria gomez: thanks all. please +1 when ready and i'll merge after a bench placeholder is added.

jo parks: +1

samir patel: +1 (fixed env var name)

alex chen: +1

maria gomez: merging in 30m unless any objections.
